title: Mass-spectral composition correspondence
statement: A mass-spectral record is the complete map from generated ionized carriers to retained mass/charge response classes and counted abundances, including precursor-fragment relations and observation conditions.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the eight registered binary coordinates; decide every form by complete distinction preservation, exact recurrence/equivalence enumeration, minimality and absence of an extra rule.
grammar_boundary: Every finite generated ionized-carrier support with complete composition, isotope, mass/charge, response and precursor-fragment records.

choices.name: neutral-sample-label-only
choices.reason: No detected carrier class is generated.

choices.name: generated-ionized-carriers
choices.reason: Each detected carrier occurrence is explicit.

choices.name: mass-charge-classes-held
choices.reason: Each response class keeps mass and charge organization.

choices.name: class-position-and-abundance-held
choices.reason: Location and counted response remain paired.

choices.name: fragment-origin-erased
choices.reason: Products cannot be related to precursors.

choices.name: ionization-and-instrument-boundary
choices.reason: Source and observation conditions are explicit.

choices.name: spectrum-image-only
choices.reason: The composition map cannot be checked.

choices.name: complete-carrier-response-trace
choices.reason: Every class, count and map is retained.

choices.name: free-peak-assignment
choices.reason: A library guess can select composition.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Generated carriers and exact class equality decide correspondence.

induction_base: One generated ion carrier and its resolved response class supply the first mass-spectral correspondence.
induction_step: Appending a carrier or fragment preserves earlier class records and adds its exact mass/charge and origin map.
exclusions: no analytical glossary, calibration curve, spectral database, measured line, fitted profile, target source or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no sample, component, response, transition, reference or unfavorable observation may be created, copied or silently erased
absence is an Empty structural form rather than numerical zero
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed
Every finite generated ionized-carrier support with complete composition, isotope, mass/charge, response and precursor-fragment records.

target_rows.source_locator: authority source set anchored at M03749

falsification_condition: The claim fails if authority evidence lacks ion mass/charge separation, abundance, composition/fragment correspondence or method boundary, or if a tampered row is accepted.
